mentions.name: modmask
mentions.description: A small LLVM-based tool that prints the source code locations of functions unreachable from main, letting developers safely delete dead code without altering functionality; it was used to remove about 3000 lines of code in minutes.
mentions.problem: Identifying unreachable code so unused functionality can be removed safely without altering behavior.
mentions.source_excerpt: For the task of removing functionality I developed a small tool based on LLVM that prints the source code location of functions that are unreachable from main, so that I can safely remove them without altering functionality, deleted ~3000 LOC in a couple of minutes[2]
mentions.author: FattiMei
